verdict.rationale: telli ships a built-in AI assistant, Charlie, documented to "build and refine agents" and "automate workflows." That is a first-party capability on the story's axis, and its MCP server also exposes Charlie to external AI tools. The evidence is a single one-line description, so the depth of the authoring help is unproven. missing for 10: documentation of generating or improving prompts from a description, generating flows from a description, any AI-generated test cases, detailed Charlie authoring docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description

citations.quote: Charlie: Build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze your calls with telli's built-in AI assistant.
The telli MCP server lets AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex talk to Charlie, telli's AI assistant, over the Model Context Protocol.
